section_summary.extract_value: This section describes exploratory factor analyses of Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) data conducted separately for migrant and non-migrant sample groups. For both groups, factor analyses revealed two factors, with the migrant sample showing a General Body Appreciation factor (10 items, α = .88) and a Body Image Investment factor (3 items, α = .64), while the non-migrant sample showed a General Body Appreciation factor (10 items, α = .90) with problematic secondary factor structure. The non-migrant sample demonstrated significantly higher general body appreciation than the migrant sample.
